[[File:Ceiling_fan_Azzameen.jpg|thumb|250px|Former satellite re-purposed into a ceiling fan]]
A '''ceiling fan''' was a motorized fan attached to a ceiling for cooling those inside the room.

[[Fazza Utral]]'s [[Hunting Lodge]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] featured a ceiling fan.<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] once stole a small [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[communications satellite]] and re-purposed it into a ceiling fan.<ref name="XWA">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>
